t: This is the former site of Bethlem Royal Hospital at Moorfields. The building is gone, but it matters because Robert Hooke designed it. Hooke was an English polymath, active as a physicist, astronomer, geologist, meteorologist and architect. He was among the first to look at living things under a microscope, using one he designed himself, in 1665. After the Great Fire of London in 1666 he gained wealth and esteem by carrying out more than half of the property line surveys and helping with the city's rapid rebuilding.
